name: Automatic Washing Machine 13kg Top Load
description: Berhome 13 kg fully automatic top-load washing machine with a stainless steel tub. Cleans deeply while being gentle on fabrics, runs quietly and saves water and energy. Its large capacity suits big families.

name: Electric Vegetable Slicer
description: Stainless steel vegetable and fruit slicer with a 120 W motor that slices up to 100 kg an hour, for potatoes, plantain, onions and more. Works electric or by hand: remove the cover, attach the handle and turn it during a power outage or outdoors. Suction feet hold it steady.
